what: The same-game table (tools/corr.js; tools/sgp.js is the rule that reads it): the tetrachoric correlation of two legs of one game at the lines DraftKings posts, each leg's expectation taken out, measured on the hub's own box scores of the finished seasons and never the season in play, shrunk toward 0 by its own standard error; and the same-game hold. Written by node tools/corr.js, never by hand (--check holds it).

measured.constants: data/props_model.json params (the props model's registered constants) and data/players.json params

lines.s: the half point nearest an even chance on the props model's distribution
lines.sv: the half point nearest the goalie's mean (saves a normal rounded to whole saves)
lines.tot: the half point nearest an even chance on the goals layer
lines.ml: the club wins, overtime and the shootout included

keys: rel|k1|k2, k1 <= k2 by string order; kinds F:<stat>, D:<stat> (g a pts s bs), G:sv, ml, pl, tot; rel self, team, opp, game, fav, dog (tools/sgp.js rhoLat reads them)

hold.rule: a game's legs: min( the product of their decimal prices, sgp / the copula's joint chance of their IMPLIED chances (DraftKings' prices, margin left in) ); games multiplied
hold.basis: the NFL site's SGP_HOLD (nfl-hub props/build/part3.js), fitted there to two real DraftKings same-game tickets on Detroit at Buffalo (2026-09-17): 7.33 and 5.36 by the copula where DraftKings offered 6.25 and 5.05, cuts of 0.852 and 0.942, 0.896 their geometric mean
hold.why_untested: no DraftKings same-game price for hockey has been recorded: ESPN's feed carries none, and neither does anything else this hub reads. Every same-game price drawn from it is an estimate and says so

report.method: rho solves sum (y1 - p1)(y2 - p2) = sum (Phi2(Phi^-1(p1), Phi^-1(p2); rho) - p1 p2) over every pair of the kind in every game of the seasons measured, p the hub's pre-game chance (the props model's distribution, the goals layer); pairs of players by the tetrachoric series, one player's two stats exactly; se cluster-robust by game; rho = raw * raw^2 / (raw^2 + se^2); |rho| <= 0.95. "bound" marks a raw rho at that cap (a player's points with his own goals or assists are nested: every goal and assist is a point, so at 0.5 the pair is one event and its rho is 1)

dk.chances: DraftKings' fair chances at its closing prices (the record, tools/props.js)

this_season.chances: DraftKings' fair chances at its closing prices; the win, the -1.5 and the total from the line the state froze at puck drop (each side's share of the two prices); nothing is chosen on these games
